name: Re:Seven -Boku ga Kimi ni Dekiru Koto-
original_name: Re:Seven 僕が君に出来るコト
source:
One night, a girl suddenly appears in front of Naoya when he is on his way home.

"I'll erase you in seven days."

Since he doesn't know who she is, he just ignores her. He comes back home and goes to bed soon.

Seven days left...

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
一天夜里，直哉走在回家路上，一名女孩突然出现在他面前。

“七天后，我会抹除你。”

直哉根本不知道她是谁，只好无视她。他回到家，很快便上床睡觉。

还剩七天…

[摘自ErogeShop]
